summary: Smoke-tested barbershop CRM backend + frontend. Admin login, seed data (3 barbers, 5 services, 3 plans), client self-register, availability, booking with 409 duplicate protection, PATCH status to Concluído awarding points/revenue/top_barber, loyalty set + admin redeem, subscriptions, dashboard stats all working. Frontend admin login routes to /dashboard; Novo Agendamento dialog loads availability and greys out the previously-booked 10:00 slot (disabled + line-through), confirming the core unavailability requirement end-to-end.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates client and returns JWT
GET /api/availability returns 20 slots for Marcos on 2026-10-12
POST /api/appointments by client creates booking (status Confirmado)
Duplicate POST /api/appointments same barber+date+time -> HTTP 409 'Este horário já está indisponível'
Client GET /api/appointments shows own (1); Admin shows all (1)
PATCH /api/appointments/{id}/status -> Concluído sets revenue_total=45, revenue_month=45, top_barber=Marcos Silva
POST /api/clients/{id}/redeem (admin) returns ok with reward message
POST /api/subscriptions by client creates Ativo subscription; admin list shows it
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns counts, series (7-day), top_barber, upcoming
Frontend: admin login -> /dashboard (toast 'Bem-vindo de volta'), KPIs render, revenue chart renders

Frontend: BookingWizard renders native selects for barber (3 options)/service, loads availability on date pick; 10:00 slot (booked via API) rendered disabled with line-through, 19 other slots enabled -> integration confirmed

failed.issue: Sidebar nav items don't carry 'nav-appointments-tab' / 'nav-*-tab' data-testids promised in test spec; navigation only works via visible Portuguese labels
failed.evidence: grep of src found no matching data-testids; Playwright click on [data-testid=nav-appointments-tab] timed out, text click worked

failed.issue: Only PATCH /api/appointments/{id}/status is implemented; the spec also mentioned PUT. Not a bug but worth confirming spec
failed.evidence: PUT /api/appointments/{id} -> 405 Method Not Allowed; PATCH .../status works

failed.issue: Single-client fetch returns 405 Method Not Allowed (no GET-by-id route); admin UI appears to use list endpoint so not blocking
